name: agenda-mes
sql:
SELECT e.dia, e.tipo, e.entidad, e.entidad_id, e.titulo,
       e.tipo_de_pendiente, e.owner_id, e.responsable
FROM (
    -- 1. Pendientes con fecha programada
    SELECT t.scheduled_for AS dia, 'PROGRAMADO' AS tipo,
           'PENDING_TASK' AS entidad, t.id AS entidad_id, t.title AS titulo,
           tp.name AS tipo_de_pendiente, t.owner_id, u.name AS responsable
      FROM pending_task t
      JOIN app_user u ON u.id = t.owner_id
      LEFT JOIN pending_task_type tp ON tp.id = t.pending_task_type_id
     WHERE t.active AND t.completed_at IS NULL
       AND t.scheduled_for BETWEEN '2026-08-31'::date AND '2026-10-04'::date

    UNION ALL
    -- 2. Vencimientos de pendientes
    SELECT t.deadline, 'VENCIMIENTO', 'PENDING_TASK', t.id, t.title,
           tp.name, t.owner_id, u.name
      FROM pending_task t
      JOIN app_user u ON u.id = t.owner_id
      LEFT JOIN pending_task_type tp ON tp.id = t.pending_task_type_id
     WHERE t.active AND t.completed_at IS NULL
       AND t.deadline BETWEEN '2026-08-31'::date AND '2026-10-04'::date

    UNION ALL
    -- 3. Vencimientos de expedientes judiciales
    SELECT c.deadline, 'VENCIMIENTO', 'JUDICIAL_CASE', c.id, c.case_number,
           NULL, c.owner_id, u.name
      FROM judicial_case c
      JOIN app_user u ON u.id = c.owner_id
     WHERE c.active AND c.deadline BETWEEN '2026-08-31'::date AND '2026-10-04'::date

    UNION ALL
    -- 4. Actuaciones judiciales. Es la unica fecha que el sistema guarda
    -- sobre ellas, y es pasada: son hechos, no previsiones.
    SELECT c.last_action_date, 'ACTUACION', 'JUDICIAL_CASE', c.id, c.case_number,
           NULL, c.owner_id, u.name
      FROM judicial_case c
      JOIN app_user u ON u.id = c.owner_id
     WHERE c.active AND c.last_action_date BETWEEN '2026-08-31'::date AND '2026-10-04'::date

    UNION ALL
    -- 5. Vencimientos de procedimientos administrativos
    SELECT p.deadline, 'VENCIMIENTO', 'ADMINISTRATIVE_PROCEDURE', p.id, p.file_number,
           NULL, p.owner_id, u.name
      FROM administrative_procedure p
      JOIN app_user u ON u.id = p.owner_id
     WHERE p.active AND p.deadline BETWEEN '2026-08-31'::date AND '2026-10-04'::date
) e
WHERE CAST('ef35dc34-b283-48da-becc-871aa64e0837'::uuid AS uuid) IS NULL OR e.owner_id = CAST('ef35dc34-b283-48da-becc-871aa64e0837'::uuid AS uuid)
ORDER BY e.dia ASC, e.tipo ASC, e.titulo ASC, e.entidad_id ASC

name: busqueda-sin-resultados-1
sql:
SELECT c.id,
       c.case_number AS titulo,
       btrim(coalesce(c.claimant, '')
             || CASE WHEN c.claimant IS NOT NULL AND c.respondent IS NOT NULL
                     THEN ' c. ' ELSE '' END
             || coalesce(c.respondent, '')) AS descripcion,
       u.name AS responsable,
       c.active AS activo
FROM judicial_case c
JOIN app_user u ON u.id = c.owner_id
WHERE(c.case_number ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\'
 OR c.claimant ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\'
 OR c.respondent ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\'
 OR c.subject ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\'
 OR c.notes ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\')
ORDER BY c.active DESC, c.updated_at DESC, c.id ASC
LIMIT 26 OFFSET 0

name: busqueda-sin-resultados-2
sql:
SELECT p.id,
       p.file_number AS titulo,
       btrim(coalesce(p.requesting_area, '')
             || CASE WHEN p.requesting_area IS NOT NULL AND p.request IS NOT NULL
                     THEN ' — ' ELSE '' END
             || coalesce(p.request, '')) AS descripcion,
       u.name AS responsable,
       p.active AS activo
FROM administrative_procedure p
JOIN app_user u ON u.id = p.owner_id
WHERE(p.file_number ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\'
 OR p.requesting_area ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\'
 OR p.request ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\'
 OR p.notes ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\')
ORDER BY p.active DESC, p.updated_at DESC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 26 OFFSET 0

name: busqueda-sin-resultados-3
sql:
SELECT t.id,
       t.title AS titulo,
       coalesce(t.description, '') AS descripcion,
       u.name AS responsable,
       t.active AS activo
FROM pending_task t
JOIN app_user u ON u.id = t.owner_id
WHERE(t.title ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\'
 OR t.description ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\'
 OR t.notes ILIKE '%sincoincidenciaperfzz%' ESCAPE '\')
ORDER BY t.active DESC, t.updated_at DESC, t.id ASC
LIMIT 26 OFFSET 0
